messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

These conditions include severe allergies.

These conditions include rheumatoid arthritis and other forms of arthritis.
These conditions include lupus.
These conditions include psoriasis and other skin conditions.
These conditions include ulcerative colitis.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

A. 'does not act on': The subject drug does not exert its effects directly on the entity specified by the object entity.
B. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
C. 'has rules on': The subject drug is subject to the rules specified by the object entity.
D. 'is not considered addictive in the way': The subject drug is not considered addictive in the manner or to the extent of the substance specified by the object entity.
E. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
